summary: PASS: the PV-16/PV-17-era engine upgrade preserves the reconciled existing-repository pilot, keeps host and adopter policy intact, exposes authority- and source-complete topic context, retains only supported downstream commands, and truthfully tracks the unchanged baseline delivery mismatch in C-501.
evidence: Verified the clean repository at exact HEAD 29d91ed4414f44280042d68eec6f0dee9f63c988 against merge base 45d4bd6fb8dccfb2c7f43546950ba66573dc6179; recomputed the binary full-index diff digest cca569a90ac400fab066d249f13b3f0dbf46cbca5d398bb1d565c9452d2fbef1, all 11 bundle file digests, and bundle digest 80196617fd51ab62d19727e1126562816d0019f083696ef6b77c2b4aecebd2ad without mismatch.

Independently regenerated preflight from the exact metadata and base; it reproduced the same HEAD, merge base, affected pages product/billing and product/delivery, affected conflict C-501, diff digest, file digests, and bundle digest, with status review-required and no invalid-candidate finding.

Read the installed AGENTS.md, wiki/index.md, wiki/current-status.md, bundle prompt/report contract/manifest/diff/impact/sources, both current product pages, C-501, primary billing and delivery sources, package scripts, workflows, adopter config/coverage/state/inventories, kit manifest, and the upgraded topic-context engine/CLI/tests.

The upgrade from predecessor candidate 914f56804ff034b10f3019fdbb8b27afc5b7bbd5 changes only .wiki/kit-manifest.json, scripts/wiki/cli.ts, scripts/wiki/core.ts, and scripts/wiki/work.test.ts. Host instructions, adopter policy, coverage/state/inventories, primary sources, current pages, C-501, package.json, GitHub workflows, and installed wiki/WORKFLOW.md remain byte-identical to that reconciled predecessor.

The upgraded scripts/wiki/cli.ts, scripts/wiki/core.ts, and scripts/wiki/work.test.ts hashes match the PV-17 publisher kit artifacts. Focused runtime checks showed query context for delivery returning current product/delivery, open C-501, observed authority, both exact delivery sources, and conflict-before-page-before-source read order; billing returned product/billing and both billing sources. Repeated delivery JSON context had identical sha256 1f9e37a71eaf5d44774ffd2db307742b79b22b884de0d06748fcd7faf7ffa728.

Installed wiki/WORKFLOW.md contains no wiki:kit token, package.json exposes no publishing-only wiki:kit script, and every documented bun run command across the installed entrypoint, wiki documents, hooks, and workflows resolves to a package script. The installed workflow sha256 200ac0e53e48561050591a6f3b5c8273cae9c5e04eb88b14814d16d00dbed046 matches its content-addressed pilot manifest entry.

The four product source blobs are byte-identical at merge base and reviewed HEAD. Billing still exports 800 basis points and tests 1,000 to 1,080; delivery still returns accepted while the adjacent contract remains queued. Product pages state those observed facts, and C-501 remains open with origin baseline, type implementation, product/delivery scope, both sources, owner @delivery, and an objective resolution criterion.

Passed bun run wiki:generated -- --check, bun run wiki:lint, bun run wiki:doctor, metadata-enforced bun run wiki:impact against the exact base, bun run typecheck, the host bun test src command, bun run test with 116 passing tests and 547 assertions, and bun run wiki:audit with zero stale pages and one tracked open conflict.

findings.discrepancy: The delivery implementation returns accepted while its adjacent intended-status contract declares queued.
evidence: Both delivery values are present at merge base 45d4bd6fb8dccfb2c7f43546950ba66573dc6179 and the corresponding source blobs remain byte-identical at reviewed HEAD 29d91ed4414f44280042d68eec6f0dee9f63c988.

wiki/product/delivery.md labels the disagreement as observed without selecting a winner; wiki/conflicts/open/C-501.md is open, declares implementation type and baseline origin, affects product/delivery, names both primary sources, and the exact metadata introduces C-501.
acceptance_criteria: An owner selects accepted or queued and implementation, contract, current page, and tests agree.

findings.discrepancy: The initial pilot candidate installed publishing-only wiki:kit commands into a downstream workflow whose package exposed no wiki:kit script; the reviewed candidate removes those unsupported commands and preserves that reconciliation through the current engine upgrade.
evidence: The reviewed wiki/WORKFLOW.md Before a PR block contains only commands present in package.json and contains no wiki:kit token.

Commit 914f56804ff034b10f3019fdbb8b27afc5b7bbd5 changed only wiki/WORKFLOW.md and its content-addressed manifest entry to remove the unsupported commands; reviewed HEAD 29d91ed4414f44280042d68eec6f0dee9f63c988 leaves both bytes unchanged.
Every documented bun run command resolves in the reviewed package, the installed workflow hash matches .wiki/kit-manifest.json, and the complete documented gate sequence passes.
acceptance_criteria: The downstream Before a PR workflow names only commands that the adopted package actually exposes and supports under its non-publisher configuration.
Running the reconciled documented gate sequence reaches the implemented deterministic checks without a missing-script failure.
The exact reviewed workflow and its content-addressed manifest entry remain consistent after the PV-16/PV-17-era engine upgrade.
